fields.description: Order the stages run in, lowest first. Gaps are allowed; two stages may not share a number.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: What this stage is called on screen.
fields.label: Stage Label

fields.description: The role an approver must hold to decide at this stage.
fields.label: Required Role

fields.description: Where to look for that approver. nearest_ancestor: walk up from the document's branch until somebody holds the role. at_level: always at a named level. fixed_node: always at one named branch.
fields.label: Resolution Rule

fields.description: The level this stage decides at, when the rule is at_level.
fields.label: Geo Level

fields.description: The one branch this stage always resolves at, when the rule is fixed_node.
fields.label: Fixed Geo Node

fields.description: How many of the resolved approvers must act. single and any_of advance on the first decision; all_of waits for every one of them.
fields.label: Completion Rule

fields.description: Whether this stage may refuse the application, or only pass it onward. At least one stage must be able to refuse.
fields.label: Can Reject

fields.description: Skipped when nobody holds the role. A stage that is not optional and resolves nobody blocks and escalates instead of passing.
fields.label: Is Optional

fields.description: How many days the approver has before this stage is counted as overdue.
fields.label: SLA Days

fields.description: What happens when it goes overdue. escalate_up: pass it to the nearest approver above. notify_only: send a reminder. none: leave it.
fields.label: On SLA Breach
